instruction: Keep tests independent, grouped, readable and free of secrets
relevant_when: Spec files, fixtures or page objects are written or reorganized
context: Tests must run alone and in any order. Shared setup belongs in fixtures or beforeEach rather than copy-pasted navigation. Page objects encapsulate locators and actions for pages used by several specs. Credentials and absolute environment URLs must not appear in test code.

checklist.name: shared-setup-extracted
checklist.rule: Setup repeated across tests lives in a fixture or beforeEach instead of being duplicated in each test
checklist.relevant_when: Several tests start with the same steps

checklist.name: tests-independent
checklist.rule: Tests do not depend on execution order or on state created by another test; describe.serial is not used to hide coupling
checklist.relevant_when: A spec file is added or changed

checklist.name: page-objects-for-shared-pages
checklist.rule: Locators and actions for a page or component used by multiple specs live in a page object or component class
checklist.relevant_when: The same page is exercised in more than one spec

checklist.name: skips-explained
checklist.rule: Skipped tests (unconditional test.skip or test.fixme) are listed for awareness in the report; each states a ticket or reason, and conditional skips state the condition. Informational, not scored

checklist.name: no-hardcoded-secrets
checklist.rule: No credentials, tokens or API keys appear as literals in test code; they come from environment variables or a secret store

checklist.name: relative-urls
checklist.rule: Navigation uses paths relative to baseURL instead of hardcoded absolute URLs
checklist.relevant_when: A test navigates to a page

checklist.name: no-debug-output
checklist.rule: Leftover console.log is not committed in specs. Diagnostic values worth keeping are attached with testInfo.attach or reported through test.step (debugging best practice). Reporter markers such as [[KEY|value]] are exempt
checklist.relevant_when: A spec file is added or changed

checklist.name: no-repeated-ui-login
checklist.rule: Authentication is established once or through a fixture or API (storageState or an equivalent), not repeated through the UI in every test
